# MoliTodo — AI-Powered Floating Desktop Task Manager

MoliTodo is an open source, AI-powered floating desktop task management application built with Electron, Vue 3, and SQLite. It provides a unique floating icon interface that lives on the edge of your desktop, offering instant access to tasks without interrupting your workflow. The application runs entirely offline with 100% local data storage, no telemetry, and no cloud dependency.

Website: https://molitodo.eztoolab.com
GitHub: https://github.com/gusibi/MoliTodo
License: MIT
Platforms: macOS (Intel + Apple Silicon), Windows 10/11 x64

---

## Features

### Floating Desktop Icon
An always-on-top floating icon on your desktop edge displaying a task count badge. Click to open the task panel; individual tasks can be popped into independent floating windows for focused work. The icon never interrupts your workflow — it's there when you need it, invisible when you don't.

### AI Task Generation
Describe your needs in natural language and AI automatically breaks them into structured task lists. Supports multiple AI providers: OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini), Google Gemini (1.5 Pro, 1.5 Flash), Anthropic Claude (3.5 Sonnet, 3.5 Haiku), xAI Grok, and custom providers. Features smart time inference, streaming output, and batch task preview before creation.

### AI Work Reports
Generate daily and weekly work reports with one click. Automatically analyzes task completion status and work patterns. Supports customizable Markdown templates with streaming generation.

### Calendar Views
Day, week, and month view modes. Click empty time slots to quickly create tasks. Integrated task list panel, today highlighting, and recurring task instance display.

### Kanban Board
Drag-and-drop kanban management with Todo, In Progress, Paused, and Done columns. Visualize task progress and quickly adjust priorities.

### Recurring Tasks
Support daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly recurrence patterns. Custom intervals, multi-day selection, end conditions, and series management with instance overrides.

### Time Tracking
Built-in start, pause, and complete workflow. Accurately records work duration for each task. Statistics for total time, average duration, and efficiency data.

### Local REST API Server
Built-in REST API server on localhost:1234 providing 11 endpoints for task and list CRUD operations. Designed for AI agents, automation scripts, and third-party tools. No authentication required (localhost-only binding). OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification included. Endpoints cover: service info, health check, API docs, OpenAPI spec, get/create lists, get/create/update/delete tasks, start/pause/complete task lifecycle.

### Privacy First
100% local SQLite database storage. Your data never leaves your computer. No cloud dependency, no telemetry, no tracking, no ads. Fully open source under MIT license.

### Multiple Themes
Light, dark, and system-following modes. Four color themes: Default Blue, Twitter, Morandi Mist, and Mint Green. Cross-window real-time sync.

### Statistics & Analytics
GitHub-style activity heatmap, daily status trend charts, completion rate stats, and work time analysis. Understand your work patterns comprehensively.

### Import & Export
Complete JSON format data backup and restore, supporting full export of tasks and lists. Worry-free data migration with full control over your data.

### Internationalization
Full i18n support with 10 languages: Chinese (Simplified), English, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, and Arabic (with RTL support).

---

## Technical Architecture

- **Electron** — Cross-platform desktop framework for macOS and Windows
- **Vue 3** — Reactive frontend framework with Composition API
- **SQLite** — High-performance local database, zero configuration, zero dependencies
- **Vite** — Lightning-fast build tool for smooth development experience
- **Tailwind CSS** — Utility-first CSS framework
- **Vercel AI SDK** — Unified AI provider abstraction layer

---

## Installation

### Download Installers (Recommended)

Visit the [Releases page](https://github.com/gusibi/MoliTodo/releases/latest) to download:
- **macOS**: DMG for Intel or Apple Silicon
- **Windows**: Setup EXE for Windows 10/11 x64

### macOS Note

The app is not notarized by Apple. On first launch or after updates, run:

```
sudo xattr -rd com.apple.quarantine /Applications/MoliTodo.app
```

### Build from Source

```
git clone https://github.com/gusibi/MoliTodo.git
cd MoliTodo
npm install
npm run dev
```

---

## API Reference

Base URL: http://localhost:1234

### Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| GET | / | Service info — name, version, links |
| GET | /health | Health check — status and timestamp |
| GET | /docs | Self-describing API docs with curl examples |
| GET | /openapi | OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification |
| GET | /lists | Get all lists sorted by sortOrder |
| POST | /lists | Create a new task list |
| GET | /tasks | Query tasks with filters (status, list, category, keyword) |
| POST | /tasks | Create a new task |
| PATCH | /tasks/:id | Partially update task fields |
| DELETE | /tasks/:id | Delete a task |
| POST | /tasks/:id/start | Transition task to doing state |
| POST | /tasks/:id/pause | Pause an in-progress task |
| POST | /tasks/:id/complete | Complete a task |

### Task Status Lifecycle

todo → doing → paused → done

- **start**: todo/paused → doing (records startedAt)
- **pause**: doing → paused (accumulates elapsed time)
- **complete**: any → done (records completedAt, cancels reminders)

### Smart Categories

| Category | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| today | Tasks due today |
| overdue | Tasks past their due date |
| upcoming | Tasks due within the next 7 days |
| no-date | Tasks without a due date |
| starred | Starred/important tasks |
| doing | Currently in progress |
| done | Completed tasks |

---

## Use Cases

- **Developers**: Manage coding tasks alongside your IDE with the floating icon. Use the local API to integrate with AI agents and automation scripts.
- **Project Managers**: Track project tasks with kanban and calendar views. Generate weekly reports automatically.
- **Students**: Organize assignments with recurring tasks and deadlines. AI generates structured task lists from natural language descriptions.
- **Remote Workers**: Time tracking built in for productivity monitoring. Statistics show work patterns over time.
- **Privacy-Conscious Users**: All data stays local in SQLite. No accounts, no cloud, no tracking.

---

## Competitive Comparison

Unlike cloud-based task managers (Todoist, Things, TickTick), MoliTodo runs entirely offline with zero subscription fees. The floating icon design is unique — no other task manager offers always-on-top desktop access without window switching. The local REST API enables integration with AI agents and automation tools that cloud-based apps cannot match.
